snippet.title: Levistone Story (by Meta-Mega Games) IOS Gameplay Video (HD)
snippet.description:
App description:

We are back! Levistone Story Global is coming!

We are Sandtime Studio, the developer of Levistone Story. It is glad to be announced that we currently operate Levistone story independently. For Levistone Story Global, we prepare numerous contents for players: new maps, new monsters, new SP heroes and new skins! Come to join the adventure of exploring Levistone world, create your hero teams, operating your camps and conquer the mysterious Abyss!

【Build your team】
Recruit hundreds of heroes, DIY skills and Levipower!

【Hatch your pets】
Get & hatch pet eggs, train and upgrade your companions!

【Exploring the abyss】
Roguelike dungeons, random challenges, thrilling combat... ever-changing adventures in Abyss!

【Run your camp】
Planting, fishing, cooking... make your camp vibrant and relax!

App Store Link:https://apps.apple.com/us/app/levistone-story/id6739518215
